##### Project general facts

Discover a haven of modern living at Albero by ORO24, a distinguished 15-storey residential masterpiece with studios, 1 & 2-bedroom apartments at Liwan, Dubai. This exclusive project introduces a limited edition homes, showcasing a fusion of contemporary elegance and natural charm.

Step into a world of exclusivity where residents are treated to a plethora of world-class amenities. From a serene library for book enthusiasts to private lounges, a party hall for grand celebrations within the community, and a health club to maintain a healthy lifestyle, it caters to diverse tastes. The arcade zone, billiards, table tennis, and a chess room further enhance the community experience, catering to both leisure and socializing needs.

The development seamlessly integrates modern technology with natural surroundings, providing breathtaking views right from the comfort of home. Marvel at the skylines, architectural brilliance, and lush green surroundings that elevate the quality of life. The fusion of contemporary features and natural beauty sets this apart as a dream destination within a community that grants easy access to renowned landmarks and establishments.

##### Location description and benefits

Liwan, situated in the heart of Dubai, is a dynamic and well-integrated residential community that offers a harmonious blend of modern living, convenience, and tranquility. Designed to provide residents with a holistic lifestyle, Liwan boasts a wide array of amenities and facilities that cater to both practical needs and recreational desires.

The community is characterized by its thoughtfully planned infrastructure, spacious landscaped parks, and pedestrian-friendly pathways, promoting a sense of connectivity and community engagement. With a mix of residential options including apartments and townhouses, Liwan caters to various family sizes and lifestyles.

Liwan's central location ensures easy access to major road networks, making commuting and exploring the city a breeze. The presence of schools, mosques, retail centers, and recreational spaces within the community emphasizes its self-sustained nature, offering residents everything they need right at their doorstep.
